Users on affected versions should download this APK directly from this release in their browser and install it over the existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Same package and original signing certificate; no re-enrollment required. This repairs the path used by future in-app updates. Backend41 enables session-long Control Settings grants; earlier Backends retain timed compatibility.48 regression scripts passed, including actual updater UI plus both bundled bridges through a source-matched native admission harness, before/after request rejection reproduction, download routing, stale replies, timeout/network-error display, and Backend41 HTTP integration.
